name: Dumb
overview: The Bible presents the condition of being 'dumb' as both a physical affliction and a spiritual bondage, often linked to demonic possession, as seen when Jesus casts out a devil from a dumb man causing him to speak (Matthew 9:32-33). Jesus' miraculous healing power restores speech among the dumb, eliciting wonder and glorification of God (Matthew 15:30-31). Additionally, the dumb state can be a result of divine judgment or spiritual oppression, demonstrated by Jesus rebuking a 'dumb and deaf spirit' to free the afflicted (Mark 9:25-26). These passages highlight Christ's authority over evil and His compassion in restoring those silenced by physical and spiritual forces.
